text:
Nina: Rapid thread to lock the benchmark narrative for the micro-launch. Need a single clear claim, a hero scatter (latency vs $/1k tokens), and 1 small supporting inset for embeddings. Timeline: assets ready by Tue noon.
Arjun: I'll re-run the slice for top 5 configs. Hero seq=256, show 64 & 1024 in an inset table. Will export p50/p95 and $/1k tokens.
Felix: Visuals: single-panel scatter (x=ms p95, y=$/1k), point shape = deployment type, size=throughput. Avoid log scales for social. Provide 1200x628 + 800x800.
Maya: Audience split: dev-first (fast + cheap) and infra (p95 + SLO). Propose two headline variants: "Speed where it matters. Costs that scale." and "Predictable p95, predictable spend."
Sam: Product note: call out routing & fallback. Small side-callout: "Auto-fallback to quantized variant keeps service available during GPU pressure." Ops teams love that.
Arjun: Data caveat: quantization reduces unit cost but increases tail in some cases. I'll flag any absolute claims; prefer "up to" phrasing. I'll attach a raw CSV link on the landing.
Nina: CTA mapping: CTA A (Try Hosted API) -> self-serve trial; CTA B (Book capacity consult) -> AE. Use UTMs so growth can route.
Felix: Design constraint: no tiny footnotes on images. Put qualifiers on landing copy or downloadable CSV. I'll also make a grayscale slide-safe version.
Maya: For paid social, use shorter headline (variant 2) and drive to the landing with the calc. For webinar, use the enterprise headline + 30-40 minute deck.
Arjun: Deliverables: CSV+JSON for calc + annotated numbers by tomorrow AM. I'll include embedding cost per 1k vectors too in case we call it out.
Nina: Action items: @Arjun data exports, @Felix mockups, @Maya UTM + paid plan, @Sam webinar outline. Review Thurs morning. 
notify-bot: Calendar created: "Benchmark Quick Launch Review" Mon 11:00.
Felix: Will keep copy minimal on image; send color checks after mock.
Arjun: I'll add a small table with p50/p95 at the three seq points for transparency.
Maya: Good. Legal/bench team: if anyone sees risky claims, flag here. We want punchy but honest.
Nina: Thanks all 680 Will stitch the final copy once data and mockups are in.
